n: the arbitrary positive integer in the theorem
x_i: the real number at index i in the arbitrary sequence
j: a second index in the sequence
k: the length of a candidate subsequence
i_r: the index of the r-th term of a candidate subsequence
r: a position within a candidate subsequence
a_i: the maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at x_i
b_i: the maximum length of a strictly decreasing subsequence ending at x_i
